text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After classes,
I'm on my way to the training
track when I see a familiar
Umamusume
accompanied by an unfamiliar one.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! Uwaaah!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That building contains both the musical
department and home ec
classrooms.
Beyond that is the indoor pool.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hokkaido was big, but I've never seen a
school this huge before! I'm
sure I'll get
lost at least once... no,
maybe five times...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hm? Aren't you Team Sirius's trainer?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Hello there.
It's nice to know you've heard
of me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A trainer?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right.
In order to run in the Twinkle Series,
you must belong to a team
run by a
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
This trainer manages Team Sirius, which
has produced many G1 race
winners.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-so you're like some kinda master! Hello!
I'm Special Week!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't call myself that... But anyway,
what are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You see, I just transferred here from
Hokkaido. Suzuka was giving me
a tour of
the campus.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But getting here's not enough to start
running races, huh? I didn't
realize I'd have
to get accepted to a team too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I wanna join Suzuka's team!
That way I can watch her
racin' up close
and personal!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... You have to be scouted to join a
team. There's no guarantee
you'll get into
the team you want...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! Scouted?! Just like a supermodel!
Then I'll just have to try
super-duper hard!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I think we should get going.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Okay, see you around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After dominating in her debut race,
Silence Suzuka finished in eighth
at the
Yayoi Sho... I would love to ask her what
happened, but...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: That's not my place.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: That's not my place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days later,
I stop by the tryouts to
scope out potential talent.
While there, I
recognize someone in the audience.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you here to watch the tryouts?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you here to watch the tryouts?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're the trainer from Team Sirius.
That's
right, I'm here to watch
Special Week.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
What a surprise this is. She just
transferred, so I didn't expect to see
her
on the roster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
New students usually learn the basics of
running and racing before
determining the
right time for them to tryout.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Sounds like she really wants to be on your team.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Sounds like she really wants to be on your team.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It certainly seems that way...
But she also
has a dream of her own.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
She wants to run in the Twinkle Series and
become the best racer in
all of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've only just met her,
but I can already tell
that Special Week faces
her dreams, her
emotions... everything head on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she says this, something in Silence
Suzuka's expression looks... almost sad. I
marvel at how different her face is now
compared to her
debut.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You sound almost jealous there.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I, well...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We've reached the third race of today's
tryouts. Each racer has taken
their place in
the gate.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's starting.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here comes number six, Special Week! She
makes up for her late start
with an early
spurt as she enters the third corner.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's closing in! Closer! Closer... she's
taken the lead!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Special Week! She just might—

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
For a new transfer,
she's got guts! I can't
even tell she's new. And that
expression...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
For a new transfer,
she's got guts! I can't
even tell she's new. And that
expression...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not just her expression...
Her running form
itself seems to embody her dreams of
coming to Tokyo and becoming the best in
Japan. However...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's this? Special Week has stopped
in her tracks and is now
waving at
someone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I did it, Suzukaaa! I got first place!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh! Sounds like she thinks she crossed
the finish line! Now the rest
of the pack is
passing her in quick succession!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll be training with you from now
on—the name's Special Week!
Thank you
for the opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! We got a new member?! Special
Week, can I call you Spe?!
Nice to
meetcha!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I was hoping to get into
Suzuka's team, but well, I
kinda messed up
in the tryouts...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But when Team Sirius' trainer scouted
me, I
remembered hearing your
team was really
great too, so I happily accepted!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo... So we're not good enough to be
your first choice, huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-no, it's not like that! Although Suzuka's team definitely was my first choice!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, tough toenails, 'cause you're stuck with us now! We'll turn you into the most miserable racer in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! The hell you waitin' for?! If you
wanna be the best in Japan,
you better
start runnin'!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-okaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her skills still need refining, but her
earnest desire to be the best has
really
made an impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I realize now that I want to help Special
Week achieve her dreams.
